gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-montserrat: Montserrat gives wide, gliding lines with generous room inside every curve. Meanwhile LXGW WenKai TC writes its headings like a relaxed hand, and Montserrat turns that looseness into something crisp and geometric.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-satoshi: Casual and graceful, LXGW WenKai TC feels like handwriting. Satoshi follows with a tall x-height and strokes of one width, so the loose pen above gets a steadier voice underneath.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-switzer: Loose handwriting up top, then a tall, wire-like Swiss voice below, with LXGW WenKai TC leading the way. Switzer's c tips stay well apart, so long text keeps its clarity.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-work-sans: Modern in outlook, Work Sans sits under the pen-drawn curves of LXGW WenKai TC with a high mean line. Its joins hold up well, so a long read stays crisp.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-cascadia-mo: Precise and structured, Major Mono Display holds every stroke at the same weight, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Cascadia Mono simply stays compact and plain sans, built for steady reading.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-julius-sans: Stark monospace meets airy sans. Major Mono Display has zero stroke contrast and a body nearly as tall as its capitals, while Julius Sans One leaves big gaps between letters and curves that stay open at the ends.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa is a plain sans with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, built from wide curves. And Major Mono Display above it keeps every stroke uniform, so the two read as one tidy system.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-giga: Major Mono Display is the sharper voice, with zero stroke contrast and terminals pulled back from each curve. But Lexend Giga does the quiet work, a plain sans with generous tracking that opens every word.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib. Major Mono Display up top shares that uniform line and near-capital lowercase height, so the two feel cut from one idea.
gen-gf-major-mono-display-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta is a sans with a big x-height, curves that never thin out, and c shapes like a wide mouth. And Major Mono Display brings a precise, structured monospace rhythm above it.
